h3: AI STRATEGY
CUSTOM DEAL FLOW
DEAL SOFTWARE
First, we study how the work happens today: the datasets, formulas, assumptions, review steps, decision logic, and outputs that drive it.

Then we structure and build the workflow for automation, combining organized data, repeatable calculations, AI agents, dashboards, reports, integrations, internal tools, and human review at the points that matter.
The approach applies across real estate, private credit, development, construction, architecture, brokerage, municipal workflows, market intelligence, and other built-environment processes.

Deepblocks scans listings, parcel data, zoning, and market signals to surface properties with real development or value-add potential, then screens every match and analyzes the strongest against your assumptions.
Plans scale with the number of opportunities delivered each month and the breadth of markets monitored.

Every selected opportunity is delivered in AIM, our deal-review CRM for Custom Deal Flow. AIM helps your team review each on-market deal and off-market lead, organize the pipeline, open the supporting analysis, and decide which opportunities should move forward.
